summary: Jim Nelson, 53, of Salt Lake City, an experienced climber, was reported overdue at 11:30 p.m. on Tuesday Aug 5 after failing to return from a Capitol Peak climb; his car was found at the trailhead late Tuesday night. A Wednesday-morning search by Mountain Rescue Aspen and the Colorado National Guard HAATS located his body at about 11:30 a.m. in the Mount Daly basin; cause of death was not released. During the body recovery a rockslide triggered by a climber above injured two MRA volunteers (one shoulder injury, one minor) and a civilian rescuer with lower-leg injuries; all were taken to hospital.
location: Mount Daly basin, near Capitol Peak
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Colorado National Guard HAATS helicopter
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE - 2014-08-06 is the search/body-recovery day per the Aug 7 2014 Aspen Daily News; incident day unknown. First 14er death in Pitkin County in 2014 per ADN. Victim count includes the 3 injured (2 MRA volunteers + 1 civilian).
